NEW ENDING + NEW ROLE IS OUT! 🎭🏆

🍫 Wonka is a story game where you and other lucky children got a golden ticket and are invited by Wonka 🎩 to his factory for a fun tour! You play games and explore his factory but things takes a lot of turns, does Willy Wonka 🎩 got it all covered? Will all the children return to their parents safely? Let's find out, good luck! 🏭

⭐ Make sure to favorite and like the game for MORE UPDATES 👍

🛒 You can also buy gamepasses in the shop to make your gaming experience easier and better! 🛒
